caption: The video showcases a macro close-up of a single faceted, pale yellow-green gemstone resting on a smooth dark-gray reflective surface, its mirror image duplicated below. The stone holds its centered position while its orientation turns gradually and continuously. The broad, bright table facet, oriented toward the viewer from the upper-left, rotates progressively edge-on, narrowing into a strip as the right-hand facets come into view. Colored dispersion flashes migrate over the facets, a violet glow at the lower edge becoming blue, then cyan-green, with a magenta edge emerging on the right. The reflection below tracks these same rotational and color changes, confirming it belongs to the turning stone.
